facts: Vietnam is long and narrow from north to south.
The Mekong Delta is an important rice-growing region.
Motorbikes are a common way to travel in cities.

ko.overview: 베트남은 남북으로 길게 뻗어 있어 도시와 삼각주, 산지가 함께 있어요.
ko.climate: 북부·중부·남부의 날씨가 동시에 다를 수 있어요.
ko.bestSeason: 지역에 따라 건기에 여행하기 더 편한 경우가 많아요.
ko.travelTips: 길거리 음식과 오토바이 풍경이 도시 여행의 인상적인 부분이에요.

overview: Vietnam stretches a long distance north to south and has busy cities, deltas, and mountains.
climate: The north, center, and south can have different weather at the same time.
bestSeason: Dry-season travel is often easier depending on region.
travelTips: Street food and motorbike traffic are a memorable part of many cities.
